recommendations.regimenLabel: Observe if mild; corticosteroids first-line if organ-threatening
steps: Confirm histology (non-caseating granulomas) and EXCLUDE TB/infection/lymphoma first.
Treat if organ-threatening (cardiac, neuro, eye, progressive lung, hypercalcaemia): corticosteroids first-line.
Screen for cardiac and ocular involvement; monitor calcium.

drugRefs.dose: 20–40 mg once daily, then taper to a low maintenance dose over 6–12 months
drugRefs.why: First-line for organ-threatening sarcoidosis (cardiac, neurological, ocular, progressive pulmonary, hypercalcaemia). Only exclude infection/TB before starting.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Sarcoidosis
ATS Clinical Practice Guideline — Diagnosis and Detection of Sarcoidosis

drugRefs.why: Preferred second-line steroid-sparing agent for chronic sarcoidosis; monitor FBC/LFTs.
Alternative steroid-sparing agent for chronic disease where methotrexate is unsuitable.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Sarcoidosis
ATS Clinical Practice Guideline — Diagnosis and Detection of Sarcoidosis

decision.label: Observe if mild; steroids if organ-threatening

confirm: Multisystem granulomatous disease — bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy, lung infiltrates ± skin/eye/cardiac involvement; non-caseating granulomas on biopsy (exclude TB).
